study.question: Can repeated training support computations be folded without losing the useful Dice normalization population and its coupled gradients, reducing measured cost while retaining the incumbent click quality above both frozen sources?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: g0-r0026-support_train_only retains click AUC0.6667535438472787 while pruning eval to30 rows, versus0.666753547526167 for full inference. Its batch p50 is18.609ms versus23.570ms for g0-r0026-support_full_bridge, but total inference times27.637s versus27.986s show that model latency and end-to-end gains differ. Training still processes70 primary rows and takes342.186s. Direct source inspection finds strata3,4 duplicated exactly as5,6 in each block when normalization_support=rotated_duplicate. Hypothesis: five unique representatives suffice for primary affine computation if the original [0,1,2,3,4,3,4] population is restored at EVERY native Dice, with differentiable gather/selection preserving total derivatives in real arithmetic. This preserves the established task-conditioned residual/history representation instead of detaching support paths. The test is primarily mechanism-preserving efficiency and an attribution check on multiplicity, not a promised accuracy gain or new scientific priority claim. Early simple compressed_task AUC0.659194 and later match_detail_task0.663019 demonstrate that compression alone was insufficient; later derivative removals (moment_neither0.666124, inputs_blocked0.666009, relational_only0.665304, marginal_only0.665794) were weaker than the attached0.666754 bridge. Those are preliminary fixed-seed observations, not independent repeated support or proof of an exact mechanism.

study.proposed_difference: Add a training_support execution choice. Folded compresses50 unique rows, applies all scorer affine layers on50, expands representatives to70 in exact block/stratum order before each original Dice, and retains the first five representatives afterwards. Compression_only expands compressed50 back to70 before all native scorer operations; full retains the original70 training path; unweighted keeps50 rows in native Dice as a multiplicity ablation. The first three strata alone feed primary/auxiliary readout exactly as inherited; the20 support representatives never enter direct readout. Empty strata remain zero rows with the original duplicate normalization mass; event counts are not normalization weights. No new learned components, loss weights, current labels, raw timestamps or filesystem/network operations enter forward. Only candidate modules and this prospective record are edited; host-owned sources, data, split, scorer, ledger and knowledge are preserved.
predictions: At a shared state, full, compression_only and folded have the same real-arithmetic forward function, total input/parameter derivatives and native BN updates. Expect exactly32129765 total/31793216 embedding/336549 dense parameters, identical state keys and initialization. Same-state train/eval outputs, gradients and buffers must be checked on host in FP32 and BF16 before training conclusions. These numerical checks have not run here.

Predeclared numerical diagnostics: representative training batches include empty, sparse, noncontiguous and full masks; compare all four probabilities (max absolute error <=1e-5 FP32, <=2e-3 BF16), gradient and running-moment relative-L2 errors (<=1e-4 FP32, <=2e-2 BF16, using denominator max(reference norm,1e-6)), exact BN counters and finite values. Also report max absolute gradient errors and near-zero cases rather than hiding them in relative errors. Compare isolated primary gradients, shared/item/action sources and permitted auxiliary context gradients, not just total BCE. These are prospective engineering gates, not statistical equivalence bounds or proof of long-run training identity.

Verify masked historical ID/action perturbations and unknown target-action perturbations leave predictions invariant as in the parent; auxiliary scorer/item ownership and original masks remain unchanged. Use authorized synthetic/train inputs only. Confirm the expanded five assignments recover the original seven row values/counts, including empty slots, and run forward/backward in both precisions.

Folded reduces primary affine row count70->50 (28.57% of this component); compression_only reduces assignment rows7->5; Dice population remains70 in folded. Neither predicts28.57% whole-training savings. Measure allocated GPU seconds, training and wall times, examples processed, peak memory and inference throughput/p50/p95. Gather/autograd overhead may erase gains.

Operational success requires same-state gates plus click AUC at least full_bridge minus0.0001, remaining above both frozen source bests, and lower measured training GPU/wall cost without a material peak-memory regression. The0.0001 margin is a predeclared engineering selection tolerance, not a statistical noninferiority claim. Report the exact loss/gain and all four AUC/Logloss metrics; a new AUC improvement is not expected from equivalent computation.

Multiplicity restoration may outperform unweighted50 if the incumbent benefit depends on the relative normalization mass of duplicate support. Direction remains uncertain; a tied or better unweighted control is informative. This contrast does not separate moment mean, variance, running-state and backward effects.

Use existing history bins empty/1-16/17-64/>64 as predeclared descriptive slices and include samples, positives and negatives. Other authorized slices are exploratory with training-defined bins and insufficient support flagged. No significance or generalization claim from one frozen seed; paired user-cluster bootstrap only if host provides authorized paired validation predictions. Repetitions or additional seeds require an authorized host phase, never a config override.
falsifiers: Any same-state discrepancy beyond the predeclared diagnostics, changed state schema/initialization, absent support derivative, wrong buffer counters, mask dependence on padding or violation of auxiliary ownership blocks the claimed implementation equivalence. BF16 drift is an implementation/numerical finding, not by itself a refutation of real-arithmetic common-subexpression folding.

If numerical gates pass but full-protocol click AUC falls more than0.0001 or measured whole-training cost does not improve, this implementation does not satisfy the proposed quality/cost benefit. Do not relabel unchanged quality alone as an efficiency success.

If unweighted50 matches or exceeds folded on quality/cost, useful duplicate multiplicity is not established for this recipe. If full70 is superior despite passing same-state checks, investigate training accumulation/precision before claiming a mechanism difference.

One fixed-seed success, repeated deterministic bridge, or historical validation selection cannot establish independent repeated support, statistical significance or production point-in-time validity. No held-out outcomes are available or requested.
alternative_explanations: Different BF16 GEMM shapes and sparse/dense gradient reduction order can change optimizer trajectories despite algebraic equivalence; an accidental AUC gain is not a new modeling mechanism.

Time differences may reflect loader/hardware variance, synchronization and expansion-memory overhead rather than reduced useful computation. Same-round full and compression-only controls plus component and end-to-end timing are necessary.

The normalization role can act through batch moments, running statistics, activation scale and coupled gradients rather than new target grouping information. The unweighted control changes this package together and cannot identify its components.

Many prior validation comparisons create selection bias. Existing attached bridges reproduce one seed, not independent random initializations. Later paired repetitions/closed assessment must not reuse holdout feedback for research.

Click selection trades off other tasks: the parent auxiliary AUCs~0.778878/0.787612/0.757167 are well below DIN~0.849070/0.864897/0.870182, although above the frozen source bests auxiliary metrics. Preserving parent click quality is not broad multitask superiority. The released offline history/static snapshots and category/brand24h auxiliary labels also limit production interpretation.
